reviews.comment: Dr. Reece makes you feel like more than just another student. She is very understanding accessible outside of class, willing to answer any type of question and will give generous extensions. 210 was really easy, with very little difficult work. Do not miss class too much, my grade took a decent hit after missing 4 classes. 100% take Reece any time

Probably my favorite professor in the entire department. Really makes you feel welcome & wanted in her class as opposed to just another student - which is really rare in this department. Her portion of the class was incredibly pleasant to be apart of. Great lectures & clearly explains topics. Exams were not over the top hard. Some homework.
